_provenance: schema-derived, DE-EOD-BASIS-001, 2026-07-02. Inputs are internally consistent: dollar_change = account_if_held_tc * account_value / 100 = 0.50 * 100000 / 100 = 500; VW TC = dollar_change / symphony_value_sum * 100 = 500 / 80000 * 100 = 0.625. invested_frac = symphony_value_sum / account_value = 80000 / 100000 = 0.8 (20% cash). VW CR back-derived: account_cr / invested_frac = 25.0 / 0.8 = 31.25. All values are untriggered (VW dry_run == VW if_held) so guard_delta_vw == 0 and expected account-basis dry_run == account-basis if_held.
_note: 20% uninvested cash makes the VW/account-basis gap unambiguous (0.625 vs 0.50 for TC; 31.25 vs 25.0 for CR). Any test that confuses VW with account-basis will diverge by >0.1 — well above any plausible floating-point tolerance.
